title: builtin.sea.kinematic parameters
description: Kinematic surface vessel limits. Units are given by key suffix. The height is pinned to the surface height; the vessel never reverses and does not turn at rest.

max_speed_mps.description: Maximum speed in meters per second.

max_accel_mps2.description: Maximum acceleration and deceleration in meters per second squared.

min_turn_radius_m.description: Smallest turn radius in meters; the turn rate is speed divided by this radius.

surface_height_m.description: Height of the sea surface above the WGS84 ellipsoid in meters (not above the geoid).
